name: Jiangsu Leuven Instruments
aliases: 江苏鲁汶仪器股份有限公司
notes: Applicant for a first-time public offering on the SSE STAR Market; not yet listed at the date of this filing draft, so it has no stock code. Business scope as the filing states it (p25, p76): R&D, manufacture and sale of semiconductor FRONT-END (前道) equipment, with ion-beam equipment and inductively-coupled-plasma (ICP) etch equipment as the core lines and CVD and vapour-phase-decomposition (VPD) metal-contamination collection equipment as auxiliary lines. It does NOT make CCP etch equipment (all plasma etchers sold in the reporting period were ICP), lithography, CMP, implant or test equipment. Originally a Sino-foreign joint venture founded 2015 by 比利时鲁汶 (Belgium), 徐州比鲁, 中科院微电子所 and 影速科技. origin/main staged this firm independently as entity 'leuven_instruments' with pending observations; that staging was superseded by this branch's verified coverage and its identifying names are folded into the aliases above.
